Two separate road accidents reported in India involving cars and pedestrians

Two separate road accidents have been reported in India. In Koderma, a speeding car hit a breakfast stall, overturning it, and injuring a youth attending a wedding. In Morena, a car driven by a groom returning from a wedding collided with a motorcycle, injuring two brothers.
